                                                                                        An Icon of Caribbean Waterfront Living

                                                                                        Welcome to Tower 7, an extraordinary opportunity to own a residence in one of Curaçao's most prestigious waterfront destinations.
                                                                                        Perfectly positioned above the sparkling Caribbean Sea, This redefining luxury living on the island—an exclusive community where elegance, luxury living, boating, privacy, and an unrivaled lifestyle come together.

                                                                                        From the moment you arrive, you'll experience a setting unlike any other. Expansive sea views, a private marina, world-class amenities, and beautifully crafted residences create a place designed for those who expect nothing but the very best.

                                                                                        Exclusive Residences
                                                                                        2-Bedroom Apartments
                                                                                        • Approximately 180 m² of refined living space
                                                                                        • 2.5 luxurious bathrooms
                                                                                        • Spacious walk-in closets
                                                                                        • Expansive terraces overlooking the Caribbean Sea
                                                                                        • First floor USD 795,000,- Second floor USD 845.000,-

                                                                                        Every residence has been thoughtfully designed to maximize natural light, breathtaking views, and seamless indoor-outdoor living.

                                                                                        Exceptional Design
                                                                                        Each apartment is delivered fully turn-key and finished to an exceptional standard.
                                                                                        Elegant European-style kitchens with premium appliances blend effortlessly into sophisticated living spaces, while luxurious bathrooms feature carefully selected high-end finishes and timeless design. Optional designer furniture packages allow you to move in and immediately embrace the resort lifestyle.

                                                                                        A Marina Lifestyle
                                                                                        Imagine beginning each morning with endless blue horizons and the gentle sound of the sea.
                                                                                        Whether you own a yacht, enjoy waterfront dining, or simply appreciate the tranquility of life by the water, The View's private marina becomes an extension of your home. Stroll along the docks, enjoy spectacular sunsets, or set sail directly from one of Curaçao's most exclusive waterfront communities.

                                                                                        Resort Living, Every Day.
                                                                                        This apartment offers the comfort and service of a luxury resort combined with the privacy of an exclusive residential community.

                                                                                        Residents enjoy:
                                                                                        • Private gated entrance with 24/7 security
                                                                                        • Professional property management
                                                                                        • Resort-style swimming pool
                                                                                        • High-speed internet included in the HOA
                                                                                        • Beautifully maintained grounds
                                                                                        • Fully equipped gym
                                                                                        • A secure and welcoming international community

                                                                                        The monthly HOA fee of USD 400 includes high-speed internet and contributes to the exceptional standard of maintenance throughout the resort.

                                                                                        Perfectly positioned in the heart of Piscadera,
                                                                                        This Resort & Marina places the very best of Curaçao within easy reach.

                                                                                        Just moments from your residence, you'll find:
                                                                                        • Three beautiful beaches within walking distance
                                                                                        • A selection of renowned waterfront restaurants
                                                                                        • The luxurious Marriott Beach Resort
                                                                                        • Dreams Curaçao Resort, Spa & Casino
                                                                                        • The vibrant restaurants and cafés of Piscadera
                                                                                        • Stylish beach clubs offering relaxed island living, fine dining, and unforgettable sunsets

                                                                                        Whether you prefer a leisurely morning by the sea, an elegant dinner overlooking the water, or a sunset cocktail at one of Curaçao's finest beach clubs, everything is just steps from your front door.

                                                                                        A Smart Investment
                                                                                        Tower 7 is more than a beautiful residence—it is an investment in one of Curaçao's fastest-growing luxury destinations.
                                                                                        Whether you choose to live here year-round, enjoy it as a second home, or generate attractive rental income through long-term or professionally managed vacation rentals, This offers remarkable flexibility and long-term value.

                                                                                        The development is situated on government leasehold land with lease rights secured through 2052, providing confidence for both homeowners and investors.

                                                                                        Experience the location.
                                                                                        Luxury is something that must be experienced.
                                                                                        Keller Williams Curaçao invites you to discover the great views through a private guided site visit. Walk the grounds, experience the marina, admire the breathtaking views, and truly feel what makes this development unlike any other on the island.

                                                                                        Our team has been extensively trained by the developer and is ready to answer every question. For technical or investment-related inquiries, we work directly with the development team to provide you with complete confidence throughout your buying journey.

                                                                                        Welcome Home
                                                                                        Imagine waking to panoramic Caribbean views, spending afternoons by the marina, and ending each day with spectacular sunsets from your private terrace.
                                                                                        This is not simply a residence.
                                                                                        This is a lifestyle.

                                                                                        Contact Keller Williams Curaçao today to arrange your private viewing and discover why Tower 7 at this Resort & Marina is one of the Caribbean's most exceptional opportunities.
